# Vendored pi-ai

This directory is a source snapshot of `packages/ai` from:

- Repository: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi
- Package: `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
- Package version: `0.85.0`
- Upstream commit: `dd7e816b57dedbe971d159b388f48317a6139079`
- Local source at import time: `E:\pi\packages\ai`
- Imported on: 2026-09-05

The upstream source and generated `dist` output are kept together so the
implementation can be studied locally while the workspace consumes the exact
vendored package. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Do not make product-specific changes directly in this directory. Put pi-ling
behavior in `packages/model-adapter`. If an upstream change is unavoidable,
record it as an explicit patch in this file and keep it small enough to rebase
onto a newer Pi snapshot.

## Local patches

None.
